title: backfill
description: One backfill run: what it listed, what it stored, and why it stopped. Progress narration goes to stderr so this payload is the only thing on stdout. Validated by the e2e-sync suite (local) rather than CI, because backfill needs a token and an API to talk to; an undeclared key is still caught at build time by Render.backfill_screen's closed record.

activities.description: activities re-listed from Strava this run

pruned.description: activities deleted locally because Strava no longer lists them

streams_fetched.description: stream rows STORED this run. Same meaning as sync's field of this name. Not the number of reads spent: a read that returns an undecodable body stores nothing, and a 404 stores an empty marker rather than streams

streams_skipped.description: reads whose body would not decode as UTF-8. Nothing was stored, so these stay pending and are retried next run. A non-zero value across repeated runs means the data is not merely late

streams_pending.description: activities still without any streams row after this run. An activity Strava has no streams for does NOT count here: a 404 stores an empty marker, which retires it permanently

stopped.description: why the run ended. complete = the queue emptied; budget_reached = stopped at the self-imposed per-run read budget; rate_limited = Strava's cap, still limited after backing off. Both non-complete reasons stop against the DAILY cap, so both mean try again tomorrow

resumable.description: whether anything is still missing — exactly streams_pending > 0. True after a complete run when a body would not decode; false after a budget stop that happened to empty the queue
